import pathlib,json,datetime,math,importlib.util
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result,sha_file
r=pathlib.Path.cwd();name="diag_night_summary_01"
refs={}
for n in ("diag_current_pair_inventory_04","diag_look_table_census_morning_01","diag_look_morning_accounting_report_01","diag_next_look_export_plan_01","t01v2_checkpoint_g01_next12_02"):
 d,ref=audited_result(r/"results"/(n+".json"));assert d["_meta"]["exit_code"]==0;refs[n]=ref
inventory=json.loads((r/"logs/review/diag_current_pair_inventory_04/current_pair_inventory.json").read_text())
census=json.loads((r/"logs/review/diag_look_table_census_morning_01/report.json").read_text())
cost=json.loads((r/"logs/review/diag_look_morning_accounting_report_01/report.json").read_text())
assert inventory["unique_count"]==101 and inventory["look_count"]==50 and sum(inventory["by_class"].values())==101
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("phase_budget",r/"scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py");b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(b)
state=b.budget_state(r)
charged={}
for group,limit in state["subbudget_limits_gpu_hours"].items():
 rows=[x for x in state["submissions"] if x["budget_group"]==group]
 charged[group]={"final_charged_GPUh":math.fsum(x["accounted_or_reserved_gpu_hours"] for x in rows if x["basis"]=="final_accounting"),"requested_ceiling_reserved_GPUh":math.fsum(x["accounted_or_reserved_gpu_hours"] for x in rows if x["basis"]!="final_accounting"),"total":state["accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget"][group],"limit":limit}
 assert charged[group]["total"]<=limit+1e-12
now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);deadline=datetime.datetime(2026,11,9,13,30,tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
report={"created_at_utc":now.isoformat(),"created_at_ET":now.astimezone(ZoneInfo("America/New_York")).isoformat(),"deadline_0830_ET_met":now<=deadline,"sources":refs,"construction_inventory_unique":inventory["unique_count"],"construction_by_class":inventory["by_class"],"Look_inventory":inventory["look_count"],"completed_frozen36":census["cohorts"]["morning36"],"new_diagnostic_GPUh_for_completed36":cost["new_diagnostic_charged_GPUh"],"next14":"frozen plan and actual CPU preflight14/14; GPU attempts and black retries preserved; no final aggregate yet","FOV":60,"pool_frozen":False,"full_T02_accepted":False,"E2E":"original fixed Look pool remains blocked at step1; no altered input or threshold; new Look T0/T3 steps2-5 unrun","G01_current":"708409 third bounded collection outside this ended inventory; incomplete candidates excluded","budget_by_group":charged,"shared_actual_or_reserved_GPUh":state["accounted_or_reserved_total"],"shared_limit":60,"budget_snapshot":state,"thresholds_changed":False}
out=r/"logs/review"/name;out.mkdir(exist_ok=False);(out/"report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
lines=["## 夜间总结（"+now.astimezone(ZoneInfo("America/New_York")).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")+"）","",
"截至已结束且独立验收的inventory04，唯一构造合格101对，其中Look50对；训练池尚未冻结，完整T02/缓存验收尚未完成。后续708409运行中候选不计入以下数字。","",
"| 类别 | 独立构造合格、去重后 |","|---|---:|"]
for key in ("direct_flip","direct_stay","look_flip","look_stay"):lines.append(f"| {key} | {inventory['by_class'][key]} |")
lines+=["","视场角按预定规则选60°；固定物体标号维持。历史未固定标号12对LookStay不计入当前库存。FP203 LookFlip19超出单场景单类cap8，作为库存保留，未伪称冻结入池。","",
"完整视角诊断：已完成的固定36对为16触发隐藏锚点画面差、18完整原生表未触发、2严格距离校验失败未知。另行CPU原始证据诊断未在这两对各74个D4视角发现该像素谓词触发，原T02失败和主表未知仍保留。36对新增PBS实际计费"+str(cost["new_diagnostic_charged_GPUh"])+" GPU·小时，含全部黑帧重试；逐作业排队表在[原记录](logs/review/diag_look_morning_accounting_report_01/report.md)。","",
"新增14对（36截止后独立通过）有固定计划及原加载器14/14预检。两组首次GPU分配均在黑帧门禁退出、未开始任何pair，原PBS/UUID/PNG/cleanup证据和费用全部保留，正按授权原样重提。尚未取得这14对最终汇总，不补齐未知结果；完整50对表待GPU完成。","",
"E2E仍停在原固定Look池第1步，未换输入或放宽规则；新Look T0/T3训练和证据前逻辑尚未测，旧Direct耗时不是新actor-KL基线。首对差异是右下地板239个像素>3、最大77，邻近离屏锚点投影，45个非锚点位姿相同；RGB支持局部光照解释但不能区分阴影/反光。","",
"生成进展：G01按1卡、6并发场景、最多8个Unity、60°继续有界训练场景探索。上一批708343独立通过25对并保留重复/零产出/失败；第三批708409仍在运行。新FP18/214恢复基线错误正在只读诊断，未改物理阈值或基准。已知物理移动和渲染门禁反复黑帧仍是阻塞。","",
"| 预算组 | 已终态实际计费GPUh | 未终态申请上限预留 | 合计 | 上限 |","|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|"]
for group in ("T01v2","G01","E2E"):
 v=charged[group];lines.append(f"| {group} | {v['final_charged_GPUh']:.6f} | {v['requested_ceiling_reserved_GPUh']:.6f} | {v['total']:.6f} | {v['limit']:g} |")
lines+=["","共享已计费及预留："+str(state["accounted_or_reserved_total"])+"/60 GPU·小时。队列倍率来自PBS；申请上限不是实际消费。每次重提仍由原预算守卫检查，所有GPU均Express/autox，不加host。","",
"夜间总结使用实际写入时间；截止13:30 UTC（美东08:30）条件："+str(report["deadline_0830_ET_met"])+". 后续终态、独立验收和新增诊断将另次更新，原记录不覆盖。",""]
text="\n".join(lines);(out/"report.md").write_text(text)
with (r/"STATUS.md").open("a") as f:f.write("\n\n"+text)
print("NIGHT_SUMMARY_JSON: "+json.dumps({"report":{"file":str((out/"report.json").relative_to(r)),"sha256":sha_file(out/"report.json")},"created_at_utc":report["created_at_utc"],"deadline_0830_ET_met":report["deadline_0830_ET_met"],"construction_by_class":report["construction_by_class"],"budget_by_group":charged,"shared":state["accounted_or_reserved_total"]},sort_keys=True))
config.scope: environment setup or diagnostic, not a research result
